Title: TC-1-001: Verify standard user logs in and is redirected to the Products page
Step Action:
Setup:
- Browser is open with no active Swag Labs session (cookies cleared or private window).
- Test data — URL: https://www.saucedemo.com/
- Test data — Username: standard_user
- Test data — Password: secret_sauce
Step Expected: All preconditions are met.

Step Action: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/.
Step Expected: The Swag Labs login page is displayed with a Username field, a Password field and a Login button.

Step Action: Enter 'standard_user' in Username.
Enter 'secret_sauce' in Password.
Click Login.
Step Expected: The browser URL changes to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html.

Step Action: Observe the page content.
Step Expected: The page header shows 'Products', the product list is displayed, and no error message is shown.

Title: TC-1-011: Reject SQL-injection and script strings in login fields without granting access
Step Action:
Setup:
- Browser is on https://www.saucedemo.com/ with no active session.
- Test data — SQL injection: ' OR '1'='1
- Test data — Script injection: <script>alert('xss')</script>
Step Expected: All preconditions are met.

Step Action: Enter ' OR '1'='1 in both Username and Password and click Login.
Step Expected: The error 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' is displayed and the URL remains https://www.saucedemo.com/.

Step Action: Reload the page. Enter <script>alert('xss')</script> in Username, 'secret_sauce' in Password and click Login.
Step Expected: No browser alert pop-up appears; the 'Username and password do not match any user in this service' error is displayed and the URL remains https://www.saucedemo.com/.

Title: TC-1-012: Display authentication errors prominently near the login form
Step Action:
Setup:
- Browser window is 1366×768 or larger, on https://www.saucedemo.com/ with no active session.
- Test data — Username: invalid_user
- Test data — Password: invalid_pass
Step Expected: All preconditions are met.

Step Action: Enter 'invalid_user' / 'invalid_pass' and click Login.
Step Expected: An error banner with a red background appears directly above the Login button and is fully visible without scrolling.

Step Action: Look at the Username and Password fields.
Step Expected: Both fields display an error (✖) icon and a red underline.

Step Action: Click the close (✖) button on the error banner.
Step Expected: The banner disappears, the field error icons are removed, and the entered values remain in the fields.
